mapper.select: SELECT A.FINPROD_TYPE FROM ( SELECT FINPROD_ID,FINPROD_TYPE FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_TYPE ='F16' UNION ALL SELECT concat_ws(ifnull(FINPROD_ID,''), date_format(VDATE, '%Y%m%d')) AS FINPROD_ID,FINPROD_TYPE FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_TYPE = 'F22' AND BRANCH_TYPE IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT ACCT_SUBJECT_ID,ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE FROM BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO WHERE ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE='F18' ) A WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{prodId} limit 1

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID, /*金融产品代码*/ A.FINPROD_TYPE, /*金融产品类型*/ ifnull(A.FINPROD_ABBR, A.FINPROD_NAME) as FINPROD_NAME, /*金融产品名称*/ A.PROFIT_TYPE, /*收益类型*/ NULL AS TERM_TYPE /*期限品种*/ FROM FIN_PRODUCT A WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND A.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} UNION ALL SELECT B.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AS FINPROD_ID, /*科目代码*/ B.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE AS FINPROD_TYPE, /*科目类型*/ B.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME as FINPROD_NAME, /*金融产品名称*/ NULL AS PROFIT_TYPE, /*收益类型*/ NULL AS TERM_TYPE FROM BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO B WHERE B.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = 'F18' AND B.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{finprodId} UNION ALL SELECT C.FINPROD_ID, /*金融产品代码*/ C.FINPROD_TYPE, /*金融产品类型*/ C.FINPROD_ID, /*金融产品名称*/ C.PROFIT_TYPE, /*收益类型*/ C.TERM_TYPE /*期限品种*/ FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT C WHERE C.BRANCH = 0 AND C.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND C.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
